evidence: Image must be smaller than 8 MB.

name: Upload ảnh trùng lặp (SHA-256 duplicate detection)

expected: Lần 2 trả về HTTP 409 Conflict: This photo was already submitted

name: AI Judge timeout (Fail-safe không tự động approve)

expected: Không bao giờ auto-approve; trả recoverable error
actual: Handled as: "AI Judge returned an empty response. Please retry."
evidence: AI Judge returned an empty response. Please retry.

name: AI trả về JSON sai định dạng (Malformed JSON)

expected: Không crash server; trả HTTP 500 kèm thông báo có kiểm soát
actual: Caught gracefully: "AI Judge returned malformed JSON. Please retry."
evidence: AI Judge returned malformed JSON. Please retry.
